name: Delhi (MCD & Anti-Plastic)
description: Collaborated with Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) featuring mascot Nivaran Dadi for school anti-plastic education and fabric bag upcycling.
stats: Municipal Corporation of Delhi • Mission LiFE

name: Mumbai (Juhu Beach & Star Awards)
description: Mobilising volunteers for shoreline plastic cleanups at Juhu Beach and presenting prestigious environmental leadership recognitions.

name: Devprayag (Ganga Riverhead)
description: Mobilising citizen cleanup drives and waste prevention from the sacred riverhead of Devprayag along the Ganga corridor.
stats: Ganga Cleanups: Devprayag to Ganga Sagar

name: Ganga Sagar (Delta Estuary)
description: River cleanup drives and plastic interception where the Ganga joins the Bay of Bengal, protecting delicate estuarine habitats.
stats: River delta waste reduction • Mission LiFE

name: Dal Lake (Srinagar)
description: Mobilising volunteers and partners to remove waste and protect high-altitude freshwater ecosystems at Dal Lake.

name: Saklana Village (Tehri Garhwal)
description: Gifting fruit-tree saplings to Himalayan families whose extensive orchards were destroyed by severe landslides, restoring soil and income.

name: Lalitpur (Bundelkhand)
description: Planting drought-hardy fruit trees in water-scarce Bundelkhand to help rural households build sustainable future income sources.

name: Anantapur (Andhra Pradesh)
program: The Canopy Project™ & Farmers for Earth
description: Restoring degraded soils and supporting farmer livelihoods in one of India's most chronically drought-prone agricultural districts.

name: Sundarbans Mangrove Corridor
description: Large-scale mangrove restoration where local women play a central role in planting and tree care to protect bio-corridors and shield against storms.

name: Energy Swaraj Yatra (15 States)
description: Partnering with Energy Swaraj Foundation and Prof. Chetan Singh Solanki, travelling 68,000+ km with 1,600 talks and empowering 20,000+ rural women.

name: Morning Assembly School Network
description: Engaging approximately 1,00,000 schools annually with Climate Clock assemblies, Eco-Comics, Earth Murals, and interactive teacher training.

name: Washington, D.C. (Global Movement)
description: Inspiring global environmental action since 1970, uniting over 1 billion people annually across 192 nations worldwide.
